capabilities: edit selected text with AI instructions and apply or chain results
chat about notes with adjustable conversation history
look up facts via web search with tool-calling models
attach note context by menu, button, drag-and-drop, or hotkey
queue messages and monitor connection status in the status bar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Web mode requires models configured for tool calling (Qwen recommended); Ollama cloud models are supported in addition to local ones; tested on GTX 1060 6GB and Apple Silicon M1.
motivation: The author wanted local LLMs to be genuinely useful for everyday note-taking with minimal settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use local LLMs for editing text, discussing notes, or looking up facts without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: This plugin connects Ollama to Obsidian, so you can use local LLMs right inside your notes.

summary: Local AI assistant that connects Ollama to Obsidian for AI text editing, chat about notes, and web search inside a side panel.
